Targ. Is. I, 8 ערסל מ׳ (ed. Wil. מַבְּתּוּתָא, corr. acc.; Regia מַבָּתוּתָא; some ed. מכ׳, corr. acc.) the hammock for night-lodging (h. text מלונה).—בֵּית מ׳ (בֵּי) lodging place.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 42:27">Targ. Gen. XLII, 27</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 9:1">Targ. Jer. IX, 1</cite> <he>מְבָתָת</he> (<he>מַבָּתַת</he>, constr.).
